items.label: Performance
items.value: Intel Celeron N4500 processor with Intel UHD Graphics,offering a burst speed of up to 4.4GHz, this laptop delivers smooth efficiency for daily tasks. Enjoy lag-free browsing, HD streaming, and seamless office productivity without slowdowns.

items.label: Display
items.value: Work and stream comfortably on the vibrant 15.6-inch diagonal FHD (1920 x 1080) IPS anti-glare display. With 250 nits brightness and anti-glare technology, it effectively reduces reflections and eye strain, making it ideal for extended work sessions, online learning, or enjoying movies in vivid clarity.

items.label: RAM & Storage
items.value: Equipped with substantial 16GB of DDR4 RAM and a rapid 256GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD, the HP G9 effortlessly tackles demanding multitasking, complex applications, and large file transfers. Experience smooth operation for productivity suites, photo/video editing, programming, and more.

items.label: Connectivity
items.value: Designed for the modern workplace, the HP G9 features a comprehensive port selection: 1 x USB-C, 2 x USB-A, HDMI 1.4b, RJ-45 Ethernet, SD card reader, and a headphone/mic combo jack, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5 and 720p HD Camera with Temporal Noise Reduction and shutter door (for privacy) for Seamless Communication and Versatile Connections.

items.label: Operating System
items.value: Preloaded with Windows 11 Pro and Microsoft Office 365 for The Web. Ideals for School Education,Designers, Professionals, Business, Remote Learning, Video Conference, etc.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad, Spill Resistant
